A collapsible block that shows the model's reasoning ("thinking") trace, kept out of the way of the answer by default.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/chat/Reasoning.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { Reasoning } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/chat";
```
